new_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires East Coast Resources
new_news.summary: Wind River Environmental acquired East Coast Resources, a Fuquay Varina-based company specializing in grease trap pumping. The deal expands Wind River's footprint in North Carolina and continues its consolidation strategy.

new_news.headline: Liquid Environmental Solutions Acquires Grease Masters
new_news.summary: In December 2025, LES acquired St. Louis-based Grease Masters, a grease trap/commercial drain line cleaning, used cooking oil, and kitchen exhaust hood cleaning provider, expanding LES's Midwest footprint.

new_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires Keystone Wastewater Services
new_news.summary: Wind River Environmental acquired Keystone Wastewater Services, a company specializing in grease pumping and drain cleaning. The 20+ year-old company strengthens Wind River's service footprint in central Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Maryland.

new_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires M&S Septic Services and Fenkner Septic Services
new_news.summary: Wind River Environmental acquired M&S Septic Services and Fenkner Septic Services, two companies specializing in septic pumping, installations, inspections and repairs and drain cleaning. Both have 50+ year histories in Pennsylvania.

new_news.headline: Goldman Sachs Acquires Liquid Environmental Solutions
new_news.summary: Goldman Sachs Alternatives acquired Liquid Environmental Solutions (LES) from Audax Private Equity. LES collects, treats, and recovers materials from liquid waste sources including grease traps, oil water separators, used cooking oil and other non-hazardous liquid waste.

new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Completes Reverse Merger with Happy Traps
new_news.summary: In March 2025, Happy Traps completed a reverse merger with Barrel Energy. The transaction was structured to provide Happy Traps with access to additional capital and infrastructure to support regional expansion and integration into a renewable energy and waste-to-value platform.

new_news.headline: Liquid Environmental Solutions Acquires All American Grease Services Companies
new_news.summary: Liquid Environmental Solutions acquired All American Grease Services Companies, a non-hazardous liquid waste company offering grease trap and used cooking oil collection services across the Gulf Coast and Southeastern United States. The acquisition adds five service branches and three wastewater treatment facilities to LES's network.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Highlights Growth in Renewable Fuels and Collagen at Investor Day
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients showcased its evolution into a global leader in rendering, collagen and renewable fuels at its May 11, 2026 Investor Day. The company highlighted Diamond Green Diesel with approximately 1.2 billion gallons of renewable diesel capacity and early adoption of sustainable aviation fuel as key growth drivers.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Swings Back to Profit in Q1 2026
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported first-quarter 2026 results with sales of $1.55 billion and net income of $134.3 million, reversing a prior-year loss. The quarter marked a clear earnings inflection with stronger margins in core ingredients and the Diamond Green Diesel joint venture, supported by favorable renewable fuel policy.

new_news.headline: EPA Finalizes Historic 2026-2027 Renewable Fuel Standard with Record-High Volumes
new_news.summary: The EPA finalized the 2026-2027 Renewable Fuel Standard with all-time-high renewable volume obligations of 25.82 billion RINs in 2026 and 25.98 billion RINs in 2027, including 70% reallocation of small refinery exemptions. Biomass-based diesel nearly doubles to 8.86 billion RINs in 2026, directly supporting renewable diesel and biodiesel producers using waste-based feedstocks like UCO.

new_news.headline: EPA Announces Final 2026-2027 RFS Volumes with 70% Reallocation of Small Refinery Exemptions
new_news.summary: EPA announced final 2026-2027 RFS volumes at the highest levels in program history, with record renewable fuel requirements. The agency reallocated 70% of exempted volumes from 2023-2025, eliminating renewable electricity (eRINs) from the program and deferring a 50% RIN reduction on imported fuels until 2028.

new_news.headline: Austin Water Breaks Ground on $1.5 Billion Walnut Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant Expansion
new_news.summary: Austin Water and City leaders broke ground on a $1.5 billion expansion of the Walnut Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant, increasing capacity from 75 to 100 MGD. The project includes advanced treatment technology, UV disinfection system replacement of chlorine gas, advanced odor control with biofilters, and a flood wall. This addresses future growth projected to reach 1.5 million residents by 2040.

new_news.headline: Weirton Wastewater Plant Upgrade Nears Completion at 96%
new_news.summary: Weirton's $38 million wastewater treatment plant upgrade project has reached 96% completion, designed to expand treatment capacity from 4 to 8 MGD. Final payments are expected in late May. The project was triggered by interest from a large manufacturing company looking to locate in the city.

new_news.headline: Austin Wastewater Plant Expansion Costs to Increase $600M
new_news.summary: City officials considered a $600 million (66%) cost increase to the Walnut Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant expansion project. The total project cost rose to $1.5 billion due to rising costs of goods and services, site constraints, and other factors. The project aims to increase capacity to 100 MGD by 2032.

new_news.headline: Governor Hochul Announces $288 Million in Water Infrastructure Funding
new_news.summary: Governor Hochul announced $288 million in grants and low-cost financing for water infrastructure projects, part of a landmark $3.75 billion plan. Funding includes IIJA grants and state resources for lead service line replacement, modernization of aging systems, and wastewater improvements across New York communities.

new_news.headline: Tipping Fee Increase at Columbia-Shuswap Refuse Facilities
new_news.summary: Refuse disposal tipping fees increased from $90 to $100 per ton, while mixed loads without recyclables removed increased to $350 per ton from $270. The increases address operational cost pressures in the regional waste management system.

new_news.headline: WEF Residuals, Biosolids and Treatment Technology Conference - Kansas City May 2026
new_news.summary: Utility leaders will gather in Kansas City in May for a focused program on biosolids management, PFAS, resource recovery, and advanced treatment technologies. The conference culminates at WEFTEC.

new_news.headline: PFAS Behavior During Water and Wastewater Treatment
new_news.summary: The Global Waste Management Symposium (GWMS) session on 'PFAS Behavior During Water and Wastewater Treatment' explored mechanics of contaminant management during treatment processes.

new_news.headline: Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program: Standards for 2026 and 2027, Partial Waiver of 2025 Cellulosic Biofuel Volume Requirement
new_news.summary: EPA establishes RFS volume requirements for 2026-2027 for biomass-based diesel and advanced biofuel. Final volumes reflect projected growth in feedstocks including used cooking oil (UCO) and animal fats, with sustained emphasis on greenhouse gas reduction.

new_news.headline: What to Know About the Section 45Z PTC Proposed Regulations
new_news.summary: Treasury and IRS issue proposed regulations for Section 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit covering transportation fuels including biodiesel from used cooking oil. Credit amounts up to $1/gallon for qualifying facilities through 2027, with heightened scrutiny on imported UCO feedstock sourcing.

new_news.headline: Valorization of used cooking oil: challenges, current developments, life cycle assessment and future prospects
new_news.summary: Academic review examining global UCO recycling landscape with annual production of 41-67 million tons. Explores waste-to-value pathways including biodiesel, bioasphalt, and biopolymers; notes only 10-20% of food service UCO is currently collected for recycling.

new_news.headline: Key Food Waste Laws & Regulations in the USA in 2026
new_news.summary: Overview of 2026 food waste regulations across U.S. states, with focus on organics diversion and compliance requirements. California's SB 1383 continues to drive industry changes; on-site biodigestion solutions and compliance infrastructure expanding.

new_news.headline: Sustainable transformation of waste cooking oil: A global review of valorization pathways and future directions
new_news.summary: Comprehensive review of WCO conversion technologies (2019-2025), highlighting biodiesel production efficiencies of 87-96% and emerging applications in bio-jet fuels, bio-asphalt, and biopolymers. Identifies need for next-generation catalysts and machine learning optimization.
